main-v1.cohort: In-house cardiac cine · constructed multi-coil k-space
main-v1.context: CardioMM-source physical masks; each subject and condition uses the same realized mask across models. Model-specific normalization, map estimation and conditioning are retained.

experiments.name: Acceleration factor
experiments.description: How does reconstruction quality change as retrospective undersampling becomes more severe?

setup.label: Input change
setup.text: Retrospectively undersample the same constructed multi-coil k-space at nominal R = 8, 16 and 24, keeping subjects matched across models.

setup.label: Published conditions
setup.text: k-t uniform, k-t Gaussian and k-t pseudo-radial masks from the CardioMM implementation; ACS width 20; seed 1. Actual R is measured from each complete realized mask, including ACS.

experiments.objective: Measure how reconstruction quality changes as fewer k-space samples are acquired, testing robustness to increasing undersampling severity.

experiments.name: Sampling pattern
experiments.description: How robust are pretrained models to changes in the physical sampling pattern?

setup.label: Input change
setup.text: Compare k-t uniform, k-t Gaussian and k-t pseudo-radial masks at each nominal R = 8, 16 or 24, with matched subjects and cross-model physical masks.

setup.label: Published conditions
setup.text: CardioMM mask implementation; ACS width 20; seed 1. Pseudo-radial masks use angle4next = 137.5, cropcorner = true and radial_acceleration_scale = 0.6. These are rasterized Cartesian masks, not NUFFT acquisitions.

setup.label: Interpretation
setup.text: Equal nominal R does not imply equal actual sampling density across patterns. Actual R is reported for each condition. VISTA is a future extension and has no published result here.

experiments.objective: Assess robustness to sampling shifts by changing the spatial-temporal support of acquired k-space. Each model is evaluated with the same realized mask for a given subject and condition.

experiments.name: ACS dependence
experiments.description: Evaluate dependence on fully sampled autocalibration signal by varying the ACS region or omitting ACS.

setup.label: Planned comparison
setup.text: Record ACS geometry and size, realized acceleration, physical-mask provenance and each model's calibration conditioning for every condition. Evaluation levels will accompany the results.

experiments.name: Noise
experiments.description: Evaluate robustness to complex Gaussian measurement noise in acquired multi-coil k-space.

setup.label: Planned comparison
setup.text: Add circular complex Gaussian noise only to acquired entries, including acquired ACS, and share each noisy measurement across models. Report target and realized SNR, noise seed and map-estimation behavior with the results.

experiments.name: Mistriggering motion
experiments.description: Evaluate sensitivity to cardiac phase inconsistencies using a phase-line replacement surrogate.

setup.label: Simulation design
setup.text: Replace a configured fraction of acquired phase-encoding lines with lines from another cardiac phase, applying the same corruption across coils. Report the realized replacement count, seed and ACS-preservation policy. This surrogate does not model a full ECG acquisition.

experiments.name: Respiratory motion
experiments.description: Evaluate sensitivity to respiratory-like inconsistencies with a controlled k-space translation surrogate.

setup.label: Simulation design
setup.text: Apply line-dependent k-space phase ramps for sinusoidal in-plane translation along canonical X, indexed by Ky line order. Record amplitude, cycles, phase and ACS preservation. The surrogate does not model nonrigid motion, through-plane displacement or scanner timing.

experiments.name: Global scaling
experiments.description: Evaluate sensitivity to the global intensity range of the input measurement.

setup.label: Simulation design
setup.text: Apply positive global factors to the input measurement while keeping the physical mask, reference and external sensitivity maps fixed. Retain model-specific normalization and raw output units. Report raw-amplitude diagnostics and scale ratios alongside scale-invariant structural quality.

experiments.name: Magnitude-derived synthetic k-space
experiments.description: Evaluate robustness to altered signal representation when the reference object's phase is removed.

setup.label: Simulation design
setup.text: Construct fft2c(complex sensitivity maps × abs(complex reference)), then apply the selected physical mask. Object phase is removed while sensitivity-map phase remains. Compare with the magnitude reference and label the input explicitly as synthetic.

experiments.name: Dataset shift
experiments.description: Evaluate generalization across datasets, anatomy and acquisition domains.

setup.label: Planned comparison
setup.text: Future CMRxRecon and fastMRI brain/knee evaluations will state dataset selection, training overlap, reference construction, preprocessing and static/cine geometry separately. Cohorts and metric protocols will remain distinct from the in-house cardiac study.
